note: Server only. Design bible entries for the classified species; see src/server/classified/index.ts.

astravex.silhouette: Tall platinum stag whose antlers are constellations.
astravex.anatomy: Long slender legs, elegant neck, flowing mane, wispy tail.
astravex.face: Long elegant head, glowing orb eyes.
astravex.materials: Platinum hide with a star-field window on the flank.

stages.summary: A wobbly fawn with a few stars in its coat.
stages.brief: Small fawn, long wobbly legs, big eyes, a few stars on its back, no antlers.

stages.summary: Its first constellation antlers appear.
stages.brief: Young deer, short antler constellations, star-field on the flank.

stages.summary: A platinum stag crowned with constellations.
stages.brief: Tall stag, full constellation antlers, flowing mane, star-field flank.

stages.summary: Infinite and calm, older than the genesis slot.
stages.brief: Majestic stag with vast branching constellation antlers, nebula mane, cosmic glow.

orbelith.silhouette: Ringed planet-being with orbiting moons and comet tendrils.
orbelith.anatomy: Spherical body, a tilted ring lined with small eyes, trailing comet tendrils.
orbelith.face: A row of small orb eyes along the ring.
orbelith.materials: Banded platinum surface with a star-field.

stages.summary: A small orb with a single eye and a thin ring.
stages.brief: Small orb, one eye, thin faint ring.

stages.summary: Its ring widens and its first moon appears.
stages.brief: Larger orb, clear ring with three eyes, one moon.

stages.summary: A ringed planet-being lined with watchful eyes.
stages.brief: Full ringed planet, five eyes on the ring, two moons, comet tendrils.

stages.summary: A world that learned to watch.
stages.brief: Grand planet with multiple rings, many eyes, three moons, long comet tails, cosmic glow.

eventide.silhouette: Eclipse-headed dragonfly with four long glass wings.
eventide.anatomy: Eclipse-disc head, small thorax, long segmented tail, four long wings.
eventide.face: Two tiny glowing eyes in a black eclipse disc with a corona.
eventide.materials: Glass wings with star patterns, dark body.

stages.summary: A small nymph with wing buds and a dim halo.
stages.brief: Small nymph, short tail, tiny wing buds, faint halo around the head.

stages.summary: Its first short glass wings unfold around a half-formed eclipse.
stages.brief: Short glass wings, longer tail, partial eclipse ring.

stages.summary: An eclipse-headed dragonfly with four long glass wings.
stages.brief: Four long star-patterned wings, full eclipse head with corona, long segmented tail.

stages.summary: It carries the stars that have already burned out.
stages.brief: Large ethereal dragonfly, wings full of galaxies, brilliant corona, trailing stardust.

helivane.silhouette: A raptor fused with a celestial body: hooked-beak falcon head, swept wings and a sun-disc corona behind the shoulders.
helivane.anatomy: Compact powerful raptor body, broad swept-back wings with long primaries, a fanned tail, strong talons and a ring of solar spines forming a corona.
helivane.face: Sharp falcon face with a hooked gold beak, fierce white-gold eyes and dark falcon cheek stripes.
helivane.posture: Wings raised and half-open, talons gripping, head turned in profile like a hunting falcon.
helivane.materials: Amber and burnished-orange plumage, pale gold breast with fine barring, white-hot feather tips, a polished gold beak.
helivane.effects: A solar corona disc with radiating rays behind the shoulders, small orbiting sun-motes. Not a phoenix: no fire trails or flame body; it is a raptor carrying a sun.

stages.summary: A fluffy amber eyas with a gold beak too big for its face and a tiny sun-spark on its brow.
stages.brief: A round fluffy raptor chick of amber down, oversized hooked gold beak, big bright eyes, stubby wings and a single small sun-spark glowing on its brow.

stages.summary: A young falcon with first flight feathers and a faint ring of light behind its head.
stages.brief: A juvenile falcon with mixed down and first flight feathers, barred breast, wings half open, strong legs, and a faint thin ring of light behind its head.

stages.summary: A solar raptor with swept wings, barred breast and a blazing corona at its shoulders.
stages.brief: A powerful adult raptor with swept-back wings, long primaries with white-hot tips, a barred gold breast, a fanned tail and a radiant corona disc behind its shoulders.

stages.summary: The Sunpiercer: wings raised wide, a full sun disc behind it and orbiting sun-motes.
stages.brief: The ascended form: wings raised wide like a crest, a full blazing sun disc with long rays behind it, crown feathers, long streamer tail feathers, and orbiting sun-motes — a falcon carrying a star.

genesis.silhouette: Floating polyhedron construct with a visor eye and orbiting Solana bars.
genesis.anatomy: Faceted crystal core, visor eye, three orbiting bars.
genesis.materials: Obsidian facets with green edge light.

stages.summary: A tiny glowing seed of geometry.
stages.brief: Small simple tetrahedron with one green light, one orbiting bar.

stages.summary: It unfolds new facets and gains a visor.
stages.brief: Octahedron core with visor, two orbiting bars.

stages.summary: A floating polyhedron construct with a visor eye.
stages.brief: Complex polyhedron, glowing visor, three orbiting bars.

stages.summary: Slot Zero: nested geometry orbiting a single unblinking eye.
stages.brief: Elaborate nested polyhedra, many orbiting bars, intense green and violet light.

nullborn.anatomy: Sitting fox, fox mask face, fanned tails.
nullborn.face: Void-black slit eyes with pink pupils, pink cheek marks.
nullborn.materials: Inverted white fur with black inner details.

stages.summary: A tiny white kit with one glitched tail.
stages.brief: Small sitting kit, one tail, big void eyes, faint glitch.

stages.summary: Its tails multiply to three and pink marks appear on its mask.
stages.brief: Juvenile fox, three tails, pink cheek marks.

stages.summary: An inverted fox with a fan of tails.
stages.brief: Sitting fox, seven tails fanned out, mask markings.

stages.summary: The Unindexed: nine glowing tails and a halo that should not exist.
stages.brief: Majestic nine-tailed fox, glowing tail tips, strong glitch distortion, inverted halo.
